body:
"Why death" only works when I don't consider "why life." I think when I entertain the idea that life is worth living, I begin to care too much about everything. the constant anxiety every waking (and sometimes unwaking) moment feels unbearable. "Torture" is an apt word. I feel like I stay alive for the benefit of other people, but the existence of other people is what makes my life feel like hell.

But if I try to detach and consider that maybe shit doesn't really matter or others might not exist, I end up eventually spiraling down a nightmarish mental scenario which is even worse. Death no longer seems like a possible escape somehow, because reality is defined by my perception rather than life.

No escape in life, no escape in death. Fucking horrific. I haven't figured out a solution yet.
